response.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT DISTINCT t.transreg, tr.tradekind FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg), c AS (SELECT tradekind, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM j GROUP BY tradekind), s AS (SELECT tradekind, txn_count, txn_count * 1.0 / SUM(txn_count) OVER () AS share FROM c), f AS (SELECT tradekind, txn_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT tradekind, txn_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_minus_avg FROM f WHERE share > avg_share

assumptions.assumption: Rows with a NULL tradekind form one group of their own. The inner joins drop behaviour records with no matching transaction or trader. If no rows survive, the average is NULL and the query returns nothing.
The 'plain average of the per-type shares' is the unweighted mean across the type groups, including the NULL group. Shares are computed as exact decimals, with no rounding.
